Remove an installed candidate for one or more packages

Usage: ocx package uninstall [OPTIONS] <PACKAGE>...

Arguments:
  <PACKAGE>...  Package identifiers to uninstall

Options:
  -d, --deselect  Also remove the current symlink (equivalent to also running `ocx deselect`)
      --purge     Delete the object from the store when no references remain after uninstall
  -h, --help      Print help
